pageDescription: Manage programs that run at startup
bootTraceNeedsAdmin: Boot trace data requires administrator privileges — restart the app as administrator to view startup impact analysis.
bootTraceNotAvailable: Boot trace analysis is not available on this platform.
errorFailedToLoad: Failed to load startup items. Make sure the app is running properly.
errorFailedToToggle: Failed to {{action}} {{name}}. This may require administrator privileges.
errorFailedToRemove: Failed to remove {{name}}. This may require administrator privileges.
confirmRemoveDescription: This will permanently remove this startup entry. The program will no longer start with Windows.

hints.impact: Impact is measured from Windows boot trace data. High-impact apps add noticeable delay to startup — disabling them can significantly speed up boot time.
hints.sources: Startup items come from different locations: the Windows Registry, the Startup folder, or the Task Scheduler. The source affects how the item is managed and whether admin rights are needed.
hints.disableVsRemove: Disabling a startup item is reversible — you can re-enable it anytime. Removing permanently deletes the startup entry.
hints.bootTrace: Boot trace data comes from Windows performance diagnostics. "Potential Savings" estimates how much boot time you could save by disabling all high-impact apps.
